build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a dynamic ball and static bars in a scene
create_static_bar: create a static bar object with configurable angle, position, and size in the scene
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object with configurable radius and position in the scene
update_task_relationships: update the task goal by defining a TOUCHING relationship between two bodies
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata to BALL for the current task scene
